build.beforeDevCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const {execSync}=require('child_process');let cwd=process.cwd();for(let i=0;i<10;i++){const frontendDir=path.join(cwd,'frontend');if(fs.existsSync(path.join(frontendDir,'package.json'))){execSync('pnpm -C '+frontendDir+' dev',{stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(0);}const next=path.dirname(cwd);if(next===cwd)break;cwd=next;}console.error('Cannot locate frontend package.json for Tauri dev');process.exit(1);"
build.beforeBuildCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const {execSync}=require('child_process');let cwd=process.cwd();for(let i=0;i<10;i++){const frontendDir=path.join(cwd,'frontend');if(fs.existsSync(path.join(frontendDir,'package.json'))){execSync('pnpm -C '+frontendDir+' build',{stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(0);}const next=path.dirname(cwd);if(next===cwd)break;cwd=next;}console.error('Cannot locate frontend package.json for Tauri build');process.exit(1);"

bundle.longDescription: notesci is a single-user, self-hosted research workspace that grounds chat responses in your own corpus of papers and notes. Multi-provider LLMs, MCP tools, citations, drafting pipeline.
